Rashi on Shabbat 149b:10:1.english: Casting lots over the nations - [This] is written regarding Nebuchadnezzar.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:12:1.hebrew: ושעירים ירקדו שם - ולא אנשים, ובשביל הבריות מסתלקין המזיקין, ונמצא מבטל גזירת המלך:
Rashi on Shabbat 149b:12:1.english: And demons shall dance there - And not people; and because of people, the harmful spirits depart, and thus [one] is found nullifying the decree of the King.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:13:1.english: The company - [The] kings who were reclining and sitting before him.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:14:1.hebrew: גם אתה חולית כמונו אלינו וגו' - ביורדי גיהנם כתיב, דכתיב לעיל מיניה: "שאול מתחת רגזה לך לקראת בואך וגו'":
Rashi on Shabbat 149b:14:1.english: Have you also become weak like us? [Have you become like] us, etc. - [This] is written regarding those who descend to Gehenna, as it is written above it: "Sheol from beneath is stirred up for you to meet your coming, etc."

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:14:2.english: You have become weak like us; to us you have been likened [eleinu nimshalta] - An expression of dominion.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:14:3.english: [Than whom] are you more pleasant - Do you think to be in [greater] pleasantness than the others?

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:1:1.hebrew: וכדברי (בית) הלל - דחייש שמא יוקירו חיטי בהלואת ככרות, אף משום רבית:
Rashi on Shabbat 149b:1:1.english: And according to the words of (Beit) Hillel - For he is concerned lest wheat become more expensive in a loan of loaves, [so it is] also on account of interest.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:2:1.english: His children and the members of his household also - Let us be concerned about interest and all these [other prohibitions].

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:2:2.hebrew: בניו ובני ביתו - הסמוכים על שלחנו, דכיון דהכל משלו, אין כאן רבית:
Rashi on Shabbat 149b:2:2.english: His children and the members of his household - Those who are supported at his table, for since everything is his, there is no [prohibition of] interest here.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:2:4.hebrew: להטעימן טעם רבית - שידעו כמה קשה. אלמא, כיון דמשלו הוא, אין כאן איסור רבית. והלכך, גבי מדה ומשקל ומנין נמי לאו קפידא הוא, אלא להשוותם בלא קנאה:
Rashi on Shabbat 149b:2:4.english: To give them a taste of interest - So that they will know how difficult [it is]. Evidently, since it is from his own [money], there is no prohibition of interest here. And therefore, regarding measure, weight, and count as well, it is not [a matter of] strictness, but rather to make them equal without jealousy.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:3:1.hebrew: אי הכי מנה גדולה כנגד מנה קטנה נמי - דמוקמינן טעמא לקמן משום קוביא, ואפי' בחול אסור. וכיון דהכל משלו, אמאי אסור? להטעימן טעמא — קוביא בעלמא הוא:
Rashi on Shabbat 149b:3:1.english: If so, a big portion against a small portion also - For we establish the reason below [as being] due to [the prohibition of] dice-gambling, and even on a weekday it is forbidden. And since everything is his, why is it forbidden [with his children]? To let them experience a taste [of it], it is merely dice-gambling.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:4:1.english: What is the reason [it is] permitted - and [why] is one not concerned about gambling [with dice]?

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:4:2.english: In accordance with [what] Rav Yehuda said [in the name of] Rav - For it is merely to give them a taste.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:4:3.hebrew: עם אחר לא כדרב יהודה אמר שמואל - דכיון דמקפידין, עוברין משום מדה ומשקל ומנין:
Rashi on Shabbat 149b:4:3.english: With another, no, in accordance with [what] Rav Yehuda said [that] Shmuel said - For since they are particular [about the portions], they transgress [the prohibition regarding] measure, weight, and number.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:4:4.hebrew: משום קוביא - דגזל הוא, דאסמכתא לא קניא. והא אסמכתא, דסמיך על הגורל: אם יפול גורל אמנה הגדולה, אזכה בה, ולפיכך תלה עצמו אף לגורל הקטנה על הספק; ואילו יודע מתחלה שכן, לא היה מתרצה:
Rashi on Shabbat 149b:4:4.english: Due to dice - For it is [considered] theft, since an asmakhta [conditional commitment] does not effect acquisition. And this is an asmakhta, because he relies on the lot: [thinking,] "If the lot falls on the large portion, I will win it," and therefore he committed himself even to the lot of the small [portion] on the chance [of winning]; whereas had he known from the outset that [it would turn out] so, he would not have consented.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:5:1.english: Of weekday - [Portions] of sacrifices from yesterday.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:5:2.english: Like those who strive with the priest - Like these priests, who are quarrelsome.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:5:3.hebrew: אפי' דחול נמי - לישתרי להו להפיס ביו"ט, כי היכי דלא לינצו:
Rashi on Shabbat 149b:5:3.english: Even [those] of a weekday as well - Let it be permitted for them to cast lots on a Festival, so that they do not quarrel.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:6:1.english: This [one said] in this manner - I will entice him in this manner.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:8:1.hebrew: שבעת קלון - בנבוכדנצר משתעי, שהיה מטיל משכב זכור על המלכים, וכשהגיע יומו של צדקיהו, נמשכה ערלתו ג' מאות אמה, והיינו שבעת קלון:
Rashi on Shabbat 149b:8:1.english: You are filled with shame - [The verse] is speaking of Nebuchadnezzar, who used to force homosexual intercourse upon the kings, and when Zedekiah's day arrived, his foreskin was stretched three hundred cubits — and that is [what is meant by] "You are filled with shame."

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:8:2.hebrew: חדא דכוליה קרא בנבוכדנצר כתיב - שפיר מצית לאוקמי כוליה בנבוכדנצר, וה"ק: שתה גם אתה — כאותם שהיית מקלה אותן; והערל — והתערל והתגנה:
Rashi on Shabbat 149b:8:2.english: One [objection is] that the entire verse is written about Nebuchadnezzar - You can well interpret all of it [as referring] to Nebuchadnezzar, and this is what [the verse] is saying: "Drink, you too" — like those whom you used to disgrace; "and be uncircumcised" — [meaning] be exposed and disgraced.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:8:3.hebrew: בשעה שעשה לו כו' - לקמן היא. מדקאמר לאותו צדיק, ש"מ אנוס היה:
Rashi on Shabbat 149b:8:3.english: When he did to him, etc. - It is [cited] later. From the fact that it says "to that righteous man," learn from it [that] he was coerced.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:9:1.hebrew: ענוש לצדיק לא טוב - צדיק המעניש לא טוב, וכיון דאינו טוב, הרי הוא רע:
Rashi on Shabbat 149b:9:1.english: Punishment for the righteous is not good - A righteous person who punishes is not good, and since he is not good, behold, he is evil.

Rashi on Shabbat 149b:9:2.english: And it is written: “Evil shall not dwell with You” - Thus, he does not enter into His partition.

Tosafot on Shabbat 149b:4:1.hebrew: מאי טעמא משום קוביא - היינו כרבי יהודה בשם רבי טרפון, דאמר: "אין אחד מהן נזיר, שלא נתנה נזירות אלא להפלאה", וסבירא ליה דלא מחית אינש לספיקא. ולית הלכתא הכי, אלא כאידך דר' יהודה, כדפסקינן בסנהדרין בפרק זה בורר (סנהדרין דף כה. ושם). מ"ר:
Tosafot on Shabbat 149b:4:1.english: What is the reason? Due to dice - This follows Rabbi Yehudah in the name of Rabbi Tarfon, who said: "Neither of them is a nazir, for nezirut is only given for a clear utterance," and he holds that a person does not enter himself into a situation of doubt. However, the law is not like this, but rather like the other [statement] of Rabbi Yehudah, as we rule in Sanhedrin in the chapter [entitled] Zeh Borer (Sanhedrin 25a and elsewhere). [From my teacher:]
